paragraphs: Modelve sells a cloud platform for asset investment planning that links condition, risk and performance data across an asset base. The site groups the offer into asset management plans, strategic modelling and value for money. Strategic modelling covers long-term infrastructure needs and compares funding, climate, risk, reliability and service-level scenarios.

The stated workflow moves from raw asset data to scenarios, dashboards, work plans and asset stories. Listed engine outputs include interactive dashboards, community storyboards, work plans, sensitivity analysis and advanced reporting. Plan documents come out in Word, Excel and PowerPoint formats.

Seeded structures aligned to IPWEA, IIMM and GFOA are offered so plans do not have to be built by hand. The customer quotes and case studies name councils, including Bass Coast Shire Council, Inner West Council and Maribyrnong City Council. Modelve lists offices in Melbourne and Toronto.

quote.text: Move from raw asset data to scenarios, dashboards, work plans and decision-ready asset stories in one connected workflow.
